sites.name: Shajgoj
sites.note: Authorised beauty retailer with brand-wise skincare catalogue; prices are server-rendered and the page shows the current selling price. Product pages live under shop.shajgoj.com/product/.

sites.name: Arogga
sites.note: Online pharmacy and beauty marketplace; product pages carry JSON-LD price and stock, and usually a higher list price to show the discount.

sites.name: BanglaShoppers
sites.note: Magento store with regular/special prices on the product page; useful for imported CeraVe, Simple and Dot & Key stock.

sites.name: MedEasy
sites.note: Health and personal-care marketplace; shows MRP and best price, JSON-LD stock. Delivery inside and outside Dhaka.

sites.name: Chaldal
sites.note: Grocery and personal-care delivery; product price is in the page's itemprop/embedded data rather than JSON-LD.

sites.name: EmartWay Skincare
sites.note: Skincare-only shop with current price and stock in page data; strong on CeraVe trial sizes.

sites.name: Beauty Line
sites.note: Korean and imported skincare shop; product page lists the selling price and the struck-through list price.

sites.name: Emart
sites.note: Imported skincare shop; WooCommerce product pages with JSON-LD price and stock.

sites.name: Aromyeo
sites.note: K-beauty shop; product pages include current price, old price and stock in JSON-LD.

sites.name: Korean Care BD
sites.note: Korean skincare shop; WooCommerce product pages with JSON-LD price and stock.

sites.name: Skincare Shop
sites.note: Imported haircare and skincare shop; WooCommerce product pages with regular/sale prices.

sites.name: Cosmetics Corner
sites.note: Cosmetics shop with WooCommerce product pages and regular/sale prices.

sites.name: IndianMartBD
sites.note: Indian imported skincare shop; product page shows the current price and old price.

sites.name: Beprincess BD
sites.note: Skincare and cosmetics shop; WooCommerce product pages with current and old prices.

sites.name: Color World
sites.note: Beauty shop in Bashundhara City; WooCommerce product pages with current and old prices.

sites.name: Glowella
sites.note: Skincare shop; WooCommerce product pages with current and old prices.

sites.name: OHSOGO
sites.note: Shopify beauty and personal-care shop; product pages carry JSON-LD price and stock.

sites.name: Chardike
sites.note: Next.js beauty shop; price, discount price and stock come from the page's __NEXT_DATA__ (chardikeVariants).

sites.name: Perfecto
sites.note: Next.js beauty shop; price, MRP and stock come from the product object in the page's RSC data (perfectoVariants).

sites.name: Korean Mart BD
sites.note: Korean skincare shop; product pages carry JSON-LD price and stock.

sites.name: Klassy Missy
sites.note: Next.js premium beauty shop; no product sitemap, so the worker reads the first page of each category from manifest/categories.xml. Product pages carry JSON-LD price and stock.
